_comment: devkit check dependencies baseline: violations that existed when DEP-02..05 arrived. key = RULE|path|name, value = occurrences, and a reason for each. New ones FAIL; an entry that no longer occurs FAILS until removed. Regenerate with `devkit check dependencies --update-baseline` after a fix, never to admit a new one.

reasons.DEP-02|roles/service_postgres/tasks/veri: target-host verify dependency installed for the role's own read-back; pinned in the next service_postgres release with a tested version
reasons.DEP-03|roles/service_postgres/defaults/m: live deployment default; pinning changes the running pgAdmin, so a tested tag lands in its own service_postgres release
live deployment default; pinning changes the running exporter, so a tested tag lands in its own service_postgres release
